mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 5.0% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates and boosts equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that precede corporate profit declines, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate a broad-based economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising), higher borrowing costs dampen economic activity and corporate profits, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during monetary tightening cycles, or the Rank IC for the regime-specific signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS is rising, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1600 thousand units signal weak residential demand, which precedes reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST is below 1600, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in FEDFUNDS and UNRATE indicates severe economic contraction where monetary tightening coincides with labor market collapse, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, decelerating industrial production (INDPRO growth below 1.5% annually) signals economic peak conditions that precede negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansions, or the Rank IC for the regime-specific signal is below 0.03.
